name: Probability bars
summary: Ranked next-word predictions: wash tracks, halo on the top pick, magenta joke tail.

slots.label: Prompt
slots.tooltip: The unfinished sentence at the top. Write ___ where the missing word goes; the blank shows in the slide's colour

slots.label: Guesses
slots.tooltip: The possible next words, most likely first. The top one glows; rows that do not fit on a small screen are left off

item.label: Word
item.tooltip: The guessed next word, shown at the left of its bar

item.label: Chance (%)
item.tooltip: How likely this word is, from 0 to 100. Bars are sized against the most likely word

item.label: Colour
item.tooltip: Pick a colour for this bar, like magenta for a joke guess, or leave it empty to use the slide's colour

props.label: Colour
props.tooltip: The slide's accent colour: the blank in the prompt and every bar without its own colour

provenance.note: The demo is the authored beat-A demo, carried (moon and tax return included).
